Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick next step to book a demo

Hi Samira —

Thanks for signing up! I’m Mateo on the SDR team. This is an automated quick touch to help you get a demo on the calendar.

Pick any 30-minute slot that works for you: https://app.redwood.ai/schedule?token=abc123

If none of the times fit, reply here with your preferred window and timezone and I’ll propose alternatives.

What we’ll cover (30 min):
- Quick product tour focused on inference performance and cost controls
- How Redwood maps to your deployment needs (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private)
- Next steps: trial access or AE intro

If you have specific goals (throughput targets, latency SLOs, compliance needs), include them in your reply and I’ll tailor the agenda.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
SDR, Redwood Inference
Mateo: +1 (415) 555-0134
